dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Program ORCR0640 is part of the ORCA (日医標準レセプトソフト) system developed by NaCl for JMA.
evidence: NaCl developer references in change log
COPY count 51 consistent with GnuCOBOL ORCA codebase

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing system — specifically inpatient (入院) diagnosis/treatment category point aggregation (診療区分別点数集計)
purpose.summary: ORCR0640 is a large batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt software suite. It aggregates and formats inpatient medical insurance claim (レセプト) data by diagnosis/treatment category, computing point totals, co-payment amounts, and various special billing items for submission to Japanese health insurers. The program handles numerous regional public expense (地方公費) variations and special billing rules across Japanese prefectures.

notable_features: 51 COPY statements indicating heavy use of shared copybooks
871 PERFORM statements indicating complex structured logic
No COMP-3 usage (unusual for financial calculations — may use COMP or display numeric)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Extensive Japanese-language comments (EUC-JP encoded, decoded as latin-1)
Detailed version history spanning 2002–2007 with many revision entries
Fixed-format source with max line length 80
verdict.notes: File decoded with latin-1 but comments are actually EUC-JP encoded Japanese text, appearing garbled in latin-1 rendering. This is characteristic of the JMA ORCA codebase. The program is clearly production-grade medical billing software with an extensive multi-year change history. No COMP-3 found despite financial calculations; numeric storage approach may rely on COMP or DISPLAY numerics. Source truncated to first 16000 chars; full file is 863KB/18039 lines.
